page.notes: The initial letter is a woodcut S (with the signature "LVCVI" in the lower left of the cut, not transcribed as text). The first line of the text begins with the word "Sapientissime" with its initial S inside the woodcut, so the opening word is shown as "apientissime" in the scan with the initial letter omitted. The line "rum" at the foot is the catchword-like continuation of the last line and is printed at the right of the page-number line. The stamp "Biblioteca Nazionale Roma Vittorio Emanuele" and the "Digitized by Google" credit are excluded.
